title: The dirty secret of capitalism -- and a new way forward | Nick Hanauer
summary: A TED talk by entrepreneur Nick Hanauer arguing that decades of 'greed is good' economic theory drove inequality and instability. He proposes an economics built on reciprocity and cooperation.
why: It is cited in inequality and capitalism threads as a billionaire's critique of neoliberal market assumptions.

quote.text: The only way we can change things on a larger scale is to change the incentives, to change the overarching goals.
